text: Creatio CRM integration, after: Vadym redesigned it around Creatio webhooks and Kafka, built as a high-throughput asynchronous PHP + Swoole microservice. Any service publishes an event to Kafka; the consumer validates it against a schema, enriches missing data such as the user's phone, converts it to an agreed JSON format and sends one POST per event. Speed and stability improved by tens of times: one consumer keeps up with the load that 8 monolith consumers sometimes could not.
